name: French fold, 4 pages
blurb: One side printed, folded twice; folded edges at the top and spine, so the back of the print never shows. Good on thin paper and inkjet.

steps.text: Print on one side (portrait), scaling off. If trimmed: cut at the two trim marks.
Fold the top half back behind the bottom half, print outside. Crease.
Fold the left half back behind the right half. That folded edge is the spine.
Front cover on top. The pages open at the bottom and right edges; leave them uncut.
Optional: make several and stack them, then staple or tape along the spine for a thicker zine.
